purpose: Apply a shared judgment to two representative alternatives.
keywords: AにしてもBにしても + common judgment
Whether reading or writing, knowing kanji is useful.
Whether going to the sea or the mountains, checking the weather matters.
In terms of both price and ease of use, this tool looks good.
formation: AにしてもBにしても + common judgment
restrictions: The alternatives illustrate a wider range, not necessarily an exhaustive list.
mistake: Do not put contradictory conclusions after the two examples.
